rooms.description: A worn stone arch leads into the tower. Dust hangs in the still air.

objects.description: The stones are worn smooth. Faint marks cover the inner curve.

rooms.description: A long hall is quiet. A cold brazier and a faded inscription wait in the dim light.

objects.description: The iron bowl is cold. Ash has settled into a hard grey crust.
The letters have faded. A few words still speak of a quiet flame.

rooms.description: A narrow alcove holds an empty pedestal. The passage back is the only way out.

objects.description: The pedestal is empty. A round hollow marks where something once stood.
